full_prompt_en: A square minimalist black-and-white cartoon places a small child and a simple robot facing each other on an otherwise empty white ground. The child stands at the left, seen in profile, with a round head, tousled hair drawn as a cluster of loose loops, a small nose, and a straight body. A plain shirt, narrow trousers, and simple shoes are indicated by only a few black lines. The robot stands on the right and is taller. Its round white head has a dark rectangular faceplate with two small pale eyes, a short antenna at the top, and a circular detail on the side. A segmented neck connects to an oval torso. Narrow arms, blocklike elbows, and straight legs with simple feet make the machine readable without technical detail. Both figures stand on the same thin, slightly uneven horizontal ground line. Above the robot, a small oval thought bubble contains three dots. A trail of three smaller circular bubbles links it diagonally back toward the robot's head. The broad upper and side margins are almost completely white, leaving the pair isolated. There is no background setting, color, shading, or visible light source; the illumination is implied by the unmarked paper. Slightly wobbly pen strokes and uneven line weight preserve the hand-drawn quality. The child's upward gaze and the robot's quiet posture make their encounter feel curious, tentative, and gently funny. The composition depends on the generous empty space around two small forms, with the floating ellipsis becoming the only narrative cue.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形极简黑白漫画把一名小孩和一个简笔机器人面对面放在几乎空白的白底上。孩子站在左侧侧面，有圆头、由松散环线构成的乱发、小鼻子和笔直身体。简单上衣、细裤与鞋仅用几道黑线提示。机器人站在右侧，个子更高。它的白色圆头有深色矩形面板与两只小浅眼，顶部一根短天线，侧面一处圆形细节。分段脖颈连接椭圆躯干。细胳膊、块状肘部、直腿与简单脚形让机器无须技术细节便清楚可辨。两者站在同一条细而略不平的水平地线上。机器人上方有一枚小椭圆思考气泡，内含三个点。三颗更小圆泡斜向连接到机器人头部。宽阔上边和两侧几乎全白，让这一对孤立其间。没有背景场景、色彩、阴影或可见光源；光由未着墨的纸面暗示。略抖的钢笔线和不均匀线重保留手绘质地。孩子向上的目光与机器人的安静姿态使相遇显得好奇、试探且温和有趣。构图依靠两个小形体周围充足的空白，漂浮省略号成为唯一叙事线索。
style_prompt_en: Minimal black-ink cartooning uses a few lightly irregular contours on an almost untouched white page. Small figures or objects stand on one thin ground line, with generous empty margins doing much of the compositional work. Avoid color, filled backgrounds, and modeled shading; only a selective dark patch or tiny symbol should carry strong contrast. Human and mechanical forms can be reduced to simple circles, ovals, and straight segments while retaining expressive posture. Hand-drawn line wobble and restrained marks make the humor quiet and immediate.
style_prompt_zh: 极简黑墨漫画在几乎未着笔的白纸上使用少量轻微不规则轮廓。小形体或物件站在一条细地线上，大量空白边缘承担构图工作。不用颜色、填满的背景或明暗塑形；仅一处选择性的深块或小符号承担强反差。人体和机械形可化为简单圆、椭圆和直线段，仍保留有表情的姿态。手绘线条轻抖与克制笔痕使幽默安静而直接。
theme_en: A small child facing a simple robot beneath an ellipsis thought bubble
theme_zh: 一名小孩面对简笔机器人，上方悬着省略号思考气泡
name: Randall Munroe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
